name: team-sales-demo
voiceover: As a team lead, you don't find out a file's stuck until the agent happens to mention it, or worse, until it's too late. This is the Team Dashboard: your whole roster, one screen, every agent's active files right where you can see them, no digging through anyone's inbox to check. Open Marcus's file and you know exactly where it stands. Closing in days, disclosures filed, survey in, title commitment done, most of his action items already checked off. Now look at Priya's contract on Alamo Heights. The Seller's Disclosure Notice was never uploaded. It's flagged right here, the request three days overdue, the kind of gap that used to surface at the title company two weeks from now, not on your desk today. That's what Team really buys you. Nothing hides in somebody else's inbox, and nothing waits for a phone call to surface. One subscription, replacing a four hundred dollar a file coordinator, for every file, every agent on your team, all at once. This is Dossie.
caption: Sales demo for Brittney/Natalie - Team plan: every agent's docs and deal status, one screen.
